title: Guide pages inside a collapsed group jump when the sidebar hydrates
detail: The server renders Cookbooks, Walk-Throughs and Reference Implementations collapsed even on a page inside them (the HTML says 'collapsed has-active'). VitePress opens the group on the client, so the sidebar jumps: CLS 0.040 on the LangChain guide and 0.028 on Semantic Search, 0 on base. With JavaScript off the current page is hidden. Every page in those three groups is affected. The shadowed VPSidebarItem could start a group open on the server when it holds the current page. Handoff 08 doesn't list this as accepted.

title: Copied markdown and llms-full.txt now carry image size braces
detail: The 17 images sized for lazy loading are written as ![…](…){width=2346 height=1792}. That syntax now appears in Copy Markdown, the raw .md files (59 built files with language variants) and llms-full.txt (22 places). Otherwise the copied text matches base byte for byte.

title: In light code, a gray token sits at the keyword's lightness
detail: The colour-blind stepping spaced keywords, strings and constants apart in lightness. A plain gray token (rgb(99,99,112), 325 spans on search.html) sits at OKLCH lightness 0.504 against the green keyword's 0.499. Readers who tell tokens apart by lightness alone may not separate the two. The gate skips low-chroma tokens, so it can't see this.

title: Prose stops at 30rem while code and tables run full width
detail: At 1440 paragraphs end about 200px short of the code blocks, tables and callouts beside them. Approved as G2 (a 60ch cap, shipped as 30rem so both fonts match). Decide whether the ragged right edge reads as intended. The cap also narrows the home page's version list.

title: The current sidebar page is no longer bold
detail: Long titles stopped rewrapping, so the current page is marked only by brand text and the lime pill. In light the pill is 1.05:1 against the page. Decide whether the current page is still obvious. The phone outline dropdown's active row is still semibold.

title: The dark search button label is dimmer
detail: The DocSearch button now uses the site grays, with 'Search' at gray 11. In dark it reads clearly dimmer than before. Approved as G16.

title: Code is coloured from the site palette, not GitHub's
detail: Every token passes AA and the token lightness is stepped apart for colour-blind readers. Fanis checked it himself. Nobody has tested long 14px reading with it yet.

title: Long titles truncate in the pinned bar and the phone breadcrumb
detail: The pinned section bar holds one line at every width and ends long titles in an ellipsis. At 360 the phone breadcrumb's page title can shrink to a stub like 'Sea…', because the version and section never truncate (G12). The full title stays in the heading and the outline.

title: Each parameter gets a # link and a Tab stop
detail: The # hit area is 44px tall but 16px wide on desktop and 20px on phones, so it doesn't cover the name. Every parameter adds one Tab stop, as headings do. Search hits could start landing on these ids after the next scrape. Nobody has checked that yet.

title: Sidebar and outline labels use text-balance
detail: Balance removes one-word last lines, but a wrapped label can look narrower than its neighbours. The handoff suggested text-pretty.

title: The faqs widget image stays 958px tall
detail: It was meant to show at 400px, as it did on the old VuePress site. Sizing it for lazy loading kept today's 958px. Restoring 400px is a visible change left for Fanis.

title: A focused zoomable image shows the browser's default ring
detail: Images are now keyboard stops, but .medium-zoom-image has no focus style. Chrome draws its 1px blue outline, not the site's lime ring. On the high-availability diagram it blends into the image's own blue frame. Found while writing the gates.

title: Code tabs are hand-built, without Home and End
detail: reka-ui Tabs cost 83 to 133ms per synced click at 4x CPU, so the tab list is hand-built. Arrow keys move and select. Home and End still scroll the page. A strip with one language is a plain label but keeps role=tab, so a screen reader reads it as 'tab, 1 of 1'.

title: Image zoom behaves like a modal
detail: Focus moves into the zoomed image on every open, mouse included, and Space closes it. Closing by overlay click, wheel or resize leaves focus on the page body. After a click close, Space can reopen an image that has since scrolled off screen.

title: Escape from search opened on the 404 lands on the nav search button
detail: The DocSearch fork always refocuses its own button. Returning focus to the 404 link needs a fork change.

title: Typing '29' finds v29 in the version picker, typing 'v29' doesn't
detail: Reka matches one text value per row, and 'v' alone matched every row, so the bare number won.

title: The phone nav can't be revealed while the outline panel is open
detail: The nav holds still while the panel is open, so scrolling up doesn't bring it back until the panel closes.

title: DocSearch loads on first use
detail: If the chunk fails to load, search stays off in that tab until a reload. Off Apple platforms the server-rendered ⌘ becomes Ctrl after mount, a 9px shift. DocSearch's CSS still ships in the render-blocking stylesheet, about 40KB.

title: Copy Markdown fetches the page's .md on click
detail: Pages no longer embed their markdown. The clipboard write waits on the fetch through a promise-valued ClipboardItem, which older Firefox doesn't support, so copy fails there. Production sends no Cache-Control on .md files.

title: Self-hosted fonts fall back to a resized Arial
detail: On a system without Arial (many Linux setups) the old fallback stack returns and so does the swap shift. Only the latin subset ships, and italic isn't preloaded.

title: Try it once in Safari and Firefox
detail: Every capture and gate ran in headless Chromium. Worth one pass in other engines: arrow keys in a code tab strip that overflows, Copy Markdown (Safari needs the click gesture, older Firefox lacks promise-valued ClipboardItem), and the font swap on a cold load.

title: On a real phone, picking a tab with the arrow keys shouldn't move the nav
detail: With a hardware keyboard on a phone or tablet, arrow keys in a tab strip shouldn't hide or reveal the phone nav. The code checks defaultPrevented, but no gate covers it.

title: The version list's edge fades follow its scroll
detail: Open the version picker, scroll the list, and press End and Home. The top and bottom fades should show only when there's more list in that direction.

title: Copy announcements stay out of the outline and search
detail: The new 'Code copied' and 'Section copied' status text shouldn't show up in the outline, the pinned bars, or the scraped search records after the next scrape.
